members.acceptance: Every repaired ledger entry is bound to an existing task specification predicate, accepted evidence class/reference/digest, and exact task revision; ambiguous or non-reconstructible entries remain blocked with a privacy-safe evidence envelope and no lifecycle weakening.
members.ownership: Coordinator post-acceptance evidence-ledger audit and repair only; preserve task authority, acceptance gates, generated projections, and prior AR history.
members.scope: Audit post-acceptance task evidence ledgers for exact predicate, evidence-class, digest, and revision correspondence; repair only the bounded authoritative ledger or publish a fail-closed blocker with exact evidence when the source acceptance is not reconstructible.
